rows.heading: Station Tenure Norms
rows.quote_snippet: 3.1 Minimum Station Tenure: The minimum normal tenure of an executive at any station shall be 3 (three) completed years. 3.2 Normal Rotation Window: Normal rotation of an executive shall be considered upon completion of 3 to 5 years at a work centre. No executive shall ordinarily be displaced prior to completing 3 years, except on administrative exigencies, organizational restructuring, or proven disciplinary necessity approved by Director (HR).

rows.heading: Cumulative Stay Cap
rows.quote_snippet: 4.1 Maximum Cumulative Career Stay: No executive shall be permitted to spend more than an aggregate of 10 (ten) years at a single city or designated Geographic Cluster over their entire career in the Corporation. 4.2 Computation of Cumulative Stay: Cumulative stay shall be computed as the mathematical sum of all historical postings (SCD2 records) served at work centres belonging to the same station or cluster, irrespective of breaks between postings or promotions in place.
